source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 4.0–4.3 cu ft Top Load Washer (WTW4100 ACU)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Run HMI Test in Service Diagnostic
steps.body: Enter Service Diagnostic mode. Press Key 1 for HMI Test — run encoder and button activation tests.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Enter Service Diagnostic mode. Press Key 1 for HMI Test — run encoder and button activation tests.

steps.title: J5 and HMI harness seated
steps.body: Power off. J5 fully seated at ACU; HMI harness and ribbon cables fully seated on HMI.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. J5 fully seated at ACU; HMI harness and ribbon cables fully seated on HMI.

steps.title: HMI harness continuity
steps.body: Continuity ACU J5 to HMI J1: J5-1↔J1-1 (Red), J5-3↔J1-2 (Yellow), J5-4↔J1-3 (Black)?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Continuity ACU J5 to HMI J1: J5-1↔J1-1 (Red), J5-3↔J1-2 (Yellow), J5-4↔J1-3 (Black)?

steps.title: Verify ACU supplies
steps.body: If HMI Test fails, run TEST #1 Main Control supply checks.
steps.sourceExcerpt: If HMI Test fails, run TEST #1 Main Control supply checks.

steps.title: Repair connections
steps.oemOutcome: Reseat J5, ribbon cables, and HMI harness; retest HMI Test.

steps.title: Replace HMI harness
steps.oemOutcome: Replace HMI harness and retest HMI Test.

steps.title: Replace user interface
steps.oemOutcome: Harness good — replace HMI assembly and verify HMI Test.

steps.title: HMI verified
steps.oemOutcome: Encoder and button activation pass in HMI Test.
